summary_en: This video provides a detailed guide on how to cook a delicious and nutritious vegetarian Gac fruit and mushroom soup for the New Year in a modern kitchen setting. Two chefs prepare ingredients, process the Gac fruit, slice mushrooms, water chestnuts, and tofu, and then stir-fry the mushrooms and simmer the vibrant soup.
